_comment: Merchant Signup Form - Stepwise Field Schema v1.0. All field keys match the API request parameter names. Slugs match the values accepted by the EMAP backend. Generated from SignupAPIController, ApplicationStepRequest, HandleOwnershipRequest, and variantA Blade views.
_dynamicDropdownEndpointsNote: Every entry has a matching key in references/dropdown-fallbacks.json. If the live GET call errors, times out, or returns an empty/missing `data` array, serve that fallback snapshot instead of an empty result — see the dropdownProxy()/DROPDOWN_FALLBACKS pattern in templates/integration-1/node-express.js.

states.note: US states only — shown only when country = US

_staticDropdownsNote: Options with a 'slug' key: send the slug value as the API param. Options with a 'value' key: send the integer or non-slug value as the API param.

steps.title: Owners
steps.description: Primary contact selection and owner identity information (SSN, DOB, driver's license, bankruptcy, home address). Supports up to 2 owners.

api.fieldNameConvention: Array notation with dot notation: first_name.1, last_name.1, ssn.1 for Owner 1; first_name.2, last_name.2 for Owner 2. Send as form fields or JSON.

fields.label: Are you the business owner / primary contact?

options.label: Yes, I am the primary contact / owner
No, I am not the primary contact / owner

fields.note: If 1: do NOT send first_name.1, last_name.1, email.1 — backend uses Step 1 user data. If 0: all three are required.

fields.label: Owner 1 First Name
fields.note: Do NOT send when primary_contact=1 — backend uses Step 1 data

fields.label: Owner 1 Phone
fields.validationNote: Use intl-tel-input library. Validates E.164 international format. Call isValidNumber() before submit.

fields.label: Owner 1 SSN / Tax ID

US.label: Owner 1 Social Security Number (SSN)
US.validationNote: 9-digit SSN in XXX-XX-XXXX format. Cleave.js applies mask automatically. Validate: ssn.replace(/-/g, '').length >= 9 (displays as 11 chars with dashes). Error: 'Please enter at least 9 digits'.

CA.label: Owner 1 Social Insurance Number (SIN)
CA.validationNote: 9-digit Canadian SIN in XXX-XX-XXXX format. Same mask as US SSN.

default.label: Owner 1 Personal Tax ID / Government ID Number
default.validationNote: For countries other than US/CA: accept plain-text tax identification or government ID number. No mask applied.

fields.note: Never store or log this value. Send over HTTPS only. For US and CA: 9 digits masked as XXX-XX-XXXX via Cleave.js (blocks [3,2,4]). The backend receives the masked value with dashes.

fields.label: Owner 1 Date of Birth
fields.validationNote: Owner must be at least 18 years old. Max date = today minus 18 years. Min year = current year minus 100. Must be a valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be enforced both client-side (date input min/max + submit-time check) AND server-side (backend recomputes age from the submitted date) — do not rely on the HTML date input's min/max alone.

fields.label: Owner 1 Ownership %
fields.validationNote: Must be a whole number — no decimals allowed. Enforced client-side via custom validPercentage jQuery validator. Decimals are rejected.

fields.label: Owner 1 License Expiration Date
fields.validationNote: Must be today or in the future (Laravel: after_or_equal:today). Reject past dates.

fields.label: Owner 1: Has a bankruptcy been filed?
Owner 1: Bankruptcy Discharge Date
fields.validationNote: Must be today or in the past (Laravel: before_or_equal:today). Future dates are rejected.

fields.note: ALL Owner 2 fields are required when ownership_percentage.1 < 51

fields.label: Owner 2 Phone
fields.validationNote: Use intl-tel-input library. Validates E.164 international format. Call isValidNumber() before submit.

fields.label: Owner 2 SSN / Tax ID

US.label: Owner 2 Social Security Number (SSN)
US.validationNote: 9-digit SSN in XXX-XX-XXXX format. Validate: ssn.replace(/-/g, '').length >= 9.

CA.label: Owner 2 Social Insurance Number (SIN)
CA.validationNote: 9-digit Canadian SIN in XXX-XX-XXXX format. Same mask as US SSN.

default.label: Owner 2 Personal Tax ID / Government ID Number
default.validationNote: For countries other than US/CA: accept plain-text tax identification or government ID number.

fields.note: Never store or log. Send over HTTPS only. For US/CA: 9 digits masked as XXX-XX-XXXX via Cleave.js.

fields.label: Owner 2 Date of Birth
fields.validationNote: Owner must be at least 18 years old. Max date = today minus 18 years. Min year = current year minus 100. Must be enforced both client-side (date input min/max + submit-time check) AND server-side (backend recomputes age from the submitted date) — do not rely on the HTML date input's min/max alone.

fields.label: Owner 2 Ownership %
fields.validationNote: Must be a whole number — no decimals allowed. Combined ownership_percentage.1 + ownership_percentage.2 must not exceed 100.

fields.label: Owner 2 License Expiration Date
fields.validationNote: Must be today or in the future (Laravel: after_or_equal:today). Reject past dates.

fields.label: Owner 2: Has a bankruptcy been filed?
Owner 2: Bankruptcy Discharge Date
fields.validationNote: Must be today or in the past (Laravel: before_or_equal:today). Future dates are rejected.
